title: I experimented with turning a single 2D image into an animated, playable platformer using img2pixi2D opensource
author: Feisty-Scheme-8356
selftext:
I've been working on another experiment with img2pixi2D.

The idea was simple: instead of just recreating a static image in PixiJS, what if I could turn it into an actual playable level?

I started with a 2D reference and explored a workflow involving scene analysis, object behaviors, animation, and world expansion.

The interesting part was going beyond the original image generated by chatGPT. A single frame doesn't tell you how objects should move, where players can walk, or how the level should continue.

For this experiment, I built a floating-island platformer with jumping, collectibles, enemies, hazards, and a goal portal.

The video shows the transformation concept and the resulting gameplay.

It's still experimental, but I think there's a lot of potential here.
